audience: delivery and logistics teams who dispatch drivers and tasks with Tookan

useCases.title: Compare successful and failed delivery tasks
useCases.text: Gets task counts per status for a date range, for one task type or team, so you can see how many succeeded, failed or are still open.

useCases.title: List tasks for a period, or find the tasks of an order
useCases.text: Lists tasks by type, date range, status, agent, team or customer, and reads full details of tasks by job id or by order id.

useCases.title: Check where an agent is and what they are doing
useCases.text: Lists agents with their status (available, offline, busy), reads one agent's profile and current tasks, and gets the last known coordinates.

useCases.title: Find a customer by phone or name
useCases.text: Finds a customer by exact phone number or searches by name or phone, and reads the profile with contact details and address.

useCases.title: Create a delivery task and assign an agent
useCases.text: Creates a delivery task for a customer address with a due date and time, then assigns it to an agent or lets Tookan assign one within the team.

useCases.title: Change a task's status by hand
useCases.text: Sets a task to a new status, for example successful, failed or cancelled, which overrides the agent app. Check the task first, because this closes it.
